licensePolicy.archive: RCSB PDB / wwPDB structure data files are CC0 1.0.
licensePolicy.attribution: Retain PDB IDs and cite original structure authors/publications in product credits even though CC0 does not require attribution.

naKATPase.title: Human alpha1 Na+,K+-ATPase in the Na+-bound E1 state
naKATPase.creator: wwPDB 9RON depositors; mesh conversion by project
naKATPase.modifications: C-alpha traces converted to 12-sided tubes; recentered, scaled, chain colored. Visual only.

nav15.title: Structure of human cardiac sodium channel Nav1.5 in intermediate open state
nav15.role: Nav1.5 visual source for cardiomyocyte membrane lessons
nav15.creator: wwPDB 9P24 depositors; mesh conversion by project
nav15.modifications: C-alpha trace converted to a 12-sided tube; recentered, scaled, colored. Visual only.

kir21.title: Cryo-EM structure of the human inward-rectifier potassium 2.1 channel (Kir2.1)
kir21.role: Kir2.1 visual source for resting membrane potential lessons
kir21.creator: wwPDB 7ZDZ depositors; mesh conversion by project
kir21.modifications: Four protein C-alpha traces converted to 12-sided tubes; recentered, scaled, chain colored. Tetramer preserved; ions excluded. Visual only.
kir21.assembly: Author-defined biological assembly 1, tetramer, identity operator; protein chains A-D

aqp4.title: Crystal Structure of Human Aquaporin 4 at 1.8 and its Mechanism of Conductance
aqp4.role: AQP4 visual source for sodium/osmolality/neuro lessons

implementation.runtimeRule: Do not render raw atomistic structures hundreds of times across a cell. Bake a simplified ribbon/surface mesh once per protein and instance that optimized mesh.

qualityTargets.mobile: LOD proxy only outside membrane close-up

implementation.physiologyRule: Protein geometry is visual only. Existing transporter state machine continues to drive open/closed/inactivated/pump-cycle behavior.
